name: AngelList (Venture)

vendor.name: AngelList Advisors, LLC / AL Venture Services

web.notes: Optional 2FA via authenticator app with downloadable recovery codes (help center). LPs see Taxes and Documents tab; tax statements exportable as PDF or CSV.

api.notes: GP side: AngelList Link page says 'API access planned for later this year' (2026). Separate GraphQL 'Investor Management API' / Data Room API exists for AngelList's Data Room and Digital Subscriptions products (GP/fund-ops customers; set up via portal@angellist.com; docs.angellist.com is auth-gated). No LP-facing API.

mcp.notes: AngelList Link (launched 2026-07-23): read-only, 28 tools (capital accounts, capital calls, distributions, documents, financial statements, partners, closes, subscriptions). Available to GPs and their teams only; LPs explicitly not yet supported ('LP use cases later'). Listed in Claude connector marketplace as verified. Not in official MCP registry.

webhooks.notes: Data Room API pushes activity events (GP product).

email_notifications.notes: LPs receive email for capital calls, statements and updates.

notes: Confidence: high on GP-only MCP server (vendor page angellist.com/link, help article on Link data & privacy, Claude marketplace listing). High on LP web features (help center: tax docs PDF/CSV, authenticator 2FA). Investor-side (LP) programmatic access: none today; AngelList states LP support planned. Terms page (venture.angellist.com/terms) could not be read (JS shell); automation policy unknown. Distinguish: MCP/API = GP audience; LP = web + email only.
